observations: Two photos show the same reverse osmosis water treatment machine from slightly different angles.
The machine has a stainless steel frame with white PVC piping and a control panel with two gauges, four buttons (two red, two green), and two toggle switches.
On top, there is a cardboard box labeled 'RA Reverse Osmosis Element' with text 'Technology derives from USA'.
The machine has two transparent flow meters on the left side of the control panel.
A pressure gauge is visible on the top piping.
The background is a concrete wall with some graffiti and pipes on the ground.
Watermark 'ENGROLA WATERS POSTED ON JIJI' is visible on both photos.

claims.evidence: Both photos show a reverse osmosis water treatment machine with filters, gauges, and control panel.
Text on the box in photo 0 and photo 1 says 'Technology derives from USA', but this cannot be verified from photos alone.
The box on top in photo 0 and photo 1 clearly labels 'Reverse Osmosis Element'.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the machine operating, with water flowing through the system and gauges responding.

risks.risk: Filters or membrane may be old or used
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the reverse osmosis membrane and pre-filters, showing condition and serial numbers if any.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown filter life

risks.risk: Piping or connections may have leaks or corrosion
risks.proof: Close-up photo of all pipe joints, valves, and fittings, especially at the bottom and connections to the pump.
risks.if_unproven: priced with assumption of potential leaks

risks.risk: Control panel components may be faulty or uncalibrated
risks.proof: Photo of the gauges with readings and a video of the buttons and switches being pressed to show response.

proof_requests: Video of the machine running with water flow and gauge readings.
Close-up photos of the reverse osmosis membrane and pre-filters.
Close-up photos of all pipe joints and connections.
Photo of the control panel gauges with readings and a video of buttons being pressed.
response.reason: The machine is identifiable as a reverse osmosis water treatment unit, but critical functional and condition details are not visible. Without proof of operation, filter condition, and integrity of connections, it cannot be priced accurately. The seller's claims about technology origin are unverifiable remotely.
